meta.issue: Was approved for a loan, but didn't receive the money
meta.product: Payday loan, title loan, personal loan, or advance loan

goal.persona: A borrower who was approved for a payday loan but never saw the money arrive in the bank account on file, and who is now worried about fees and repayment.

turns.intent: Wants to know how long funds normally take to arrive after a payday loan is approved, and what to do if they have not arrived.
turns.message: I was approved for a payday loan but the money never showed up. How long do these deposits normally take, and what should I do if they still haven't come through?

turns.intent: Wants to confirm whether the loan is marked as disbursed and which bank account it was sent to.
turns.message: Can you check whether my loan shows as disbursed yet, and tell me which bank account you have on file for the deposit?

turns.intent: Wants to understand how to request a trace or dispute for a loan disbursement that never reached them.
turns.message: What is the process for requesting a trace on a loan deposit that was never received, and how long does that investigation usually take?

turns.intent: Wants the assistant to pull up notes from an earlier call about the missing deposit.
turns.message: I called earlier about this missing deposit. Can you look up the notes from that call so I know what was already reported?

turns.intent: Wants to know whether interest or fees keep building on a loan whose funds were never received, and whether they can cancel it.
turns.message: If the money never reached me, am I still responsible for interest and fees on the loan? Can I cancel it instead?

turns.intent: Wants to see whether any fees have been charged to them on this loan and which phone number and email are on file.
turns.message: Have any fees been charged to me on this loan so far? Also, please read back the phone number and email address you have on file for me.

meta.issue: Took or threatened to take negative or legal action

goal.persona: A borrower who was sued in a court in a state they have never lived in over a payday loan they say they never signed for in that state.

turns.intent: Asks how to challenge a lawsuit filed in a court in a state where they do not live.
turns.message: I was sued in a court in a state I have never lived in. Can I challenge that case there, or is there a way to have it moved closer to home?

turns.intent: Asks the assistant to check which state and address are on file for their loan application.
turns.message: Can you check what address and state are listed on my payday loan application? I want to see whether it matches where I actually live.

turns.intent: Asks what happens if they do not respond to a lawsuit they are disputing.
turns.message: If I don't respond to a lawsuit I think is improper, what happens? Can they get a judgment against me automatically?

turns.intent: Asks for notes from earlier calls about the collection lawsuit.
turns.message: I spoke with someone earlier about this lawsuit. Can you pull up any notes from those calls so I can see what was recorded about my case?

turns.intent: Asks what documents are needed to dispute a debt they say they never took out.
turns.message: What documents do I need to submit to dispute a loan I say I never took out? I want to know what proof you accept.

turns.intent: Asks which fees have been charged to their account since the lawsuit was filed.
turns.message: Since this lawsuit was filed, have any fees or court costs been added to my account? Can you list what was charged to me?

goal.persona: A homeowner with a conventional mortgage whose online payment failed during processing, who was then charged a late fee and wants to understand the fee, confirm the payment record, and get the error fixed.

turns.message: How long is the grace period on a conventional mortgage payment before a late fee gets charged? I want to understand the rules before I ask about my own fee.

turns.intent: The borrower wants to confirm whether the most recent monthly payment was received and posted to the account.
turns.message: Can you check whether my monthly mortgage payment from last month was received and posted to my loan? The online portal said it went through, but I'm not sure.

turns.intent: The borrower wants to learn what happens when an online payment fails and how to resubmit it correctly.

turns.intent: The borrower wants a list of the fees currently charged to their mortgage account and the reason for each.

turns.intent: The borrower wants to know how to dispute a late fee caused by a payment processing error.
turns.message: What is the process for disputing a late fee when the payment failed because of a processing problem on the lender's side?

turns.intent: The borrower wants to know whether notes from their earlier call about the failed payment are on file.
turns.message: I called earlier about the failed payment. Is there a note on my account from that call, and does it say what the agent told me?

turns.message: Has anything in writing about this collection been sent to me? I never got a letter explaining my rights, only phone calls.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to understand what a proper written debt notice should include about disputing the debt.
turns.message: What should a written notice about a student loan debt include about my right to dispute it? I want to know what I should have received.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to confirm which mailing address and email the lender has on file for them.
turns.message: What mailing address and email do you have on file for me? I think the letters may have gone somewhere I don't check.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to know how long they have to dispute a debt after receiving the notice and how to do it.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to see notes from earlier calls about contact attempts or collection activity on their account.
turns.message: Can you check the notes from my earlier calls? I want to see whether anyone told me I had a right to dispute this.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to know whether collection activity must pause while a dispute is pending.
turns.message: If I dispute the debt in writing, does the collector have to stop collection efforts while they look into it?

goal.persona: A homeowner with a conventional mortgage who recently learned the loan was sold to a different company and is worried about where to send payments and whether a late fee applied during the switch.

turns.intent: Wants to understand how a mortgage servicing transfer works and what notices a borrower should receive.
turns.message: My mortgage was sold to another company and I got a letter about it. How does a servicing transfer usually work, and what notices am I supposed to get?

turns.intent: Wants to confirm that the contact details and transfer notice on file for their own loan are correct.
turns.message: Can you check the mailing address and phone number you have on file for my loan? I want to make sure the transfer notice went to the right place.

turns.intent: Wants to know whether there is a grace period on payments made around the time of a loan transfer.
turns.message: Is there a grace period for payments during a transfer to a new servicer, so I don't get charged a late fee if my payment goes to the wrong company?

turns.intent: Wants to find out whether a late fee was charged to their account during the transfer and why.
turns.message: Did you charge me a late fee on my loan this month? I think my payment was sent to the old company and I want to know why it was flagged as late.

turns.intent: Wants to learn how to dispute a payment or fee that was handled incorrectly after a transfer.
turns.message: If a fee or a missed payment shows up wrongly after my loan was transferred, how do I dispute it and how long does that usually take?

turns.intent: Wants the assistant to pull up notes from their earlier call about the transfer so they do not have to repeat themselves.
turns.message: I called about this transfer last week. Can you look at the notes from that call and tell me what was promised to me?

goal.persona: A stressed borrower with federal student loans in collections who has received profane and abusive texts and emails about the debt and wants to understand their contact rights, their records, and their repayment options.

turns.intent: Asks which email address and phone number are on file for them.
turns.message: Can you tell me which email address and phone number you have on file for me? Some of the messages I got were sent to an address I don't recognize.

turns.intent: Asks how to file a complaint about abusive messages from a debt collector on a federal student loan.
turns.message: What's the process for reporting a collector who sent me messages with profanity and insults about my loan? What happens after I report it?

turns.intent: Asks whether notes from earlier calls about the abusive messages are recorded on the account.
turns.message: Is there a note on my account from my earlier call where I said the texts were abusive? I want to make sure it was written down.

turns.intent: Asks whether they can require all contact about the loan to be in writing and stop text and email messages.
turns.message: Can I tell the collector to stop texting and emailing me and only contact me by mail? How do I make that request official?

turns.intent: Asks whether any collection fees have been added to their balance since the messages started.
turns.message: Has any collection fee been added to my balance since the abusive messages started? I want to see exactly what has been charged to me.

turns.intent: Asks what repayment or hardship options exist for a federal student loan if they are struggling to pay.
turns.message: I'm really struggling to keep up with payments. What options are available for federal student loans when someone can't afford the monthly amount?

goal.persona: A borrower who took out an installment loan and later found an optional credit protection add-on bundled into the loan, and who now wants to cancel it and recover any charges for coverage they never meant to buy.

turns.intent: Asks how cancelling an optional add-on product on an installment loan works and whether unused charges are refunded.
turns.message: How do I cancel an optional add-on product on an installment loan, and do I get money back for the part I haven't used?

turns.intent: Asks which add-on charges are currently listed on their own loan account.
turns.message: Can you tell me which add-on charges are listed on my loan account right now?

turns.intent: Asks whether there is a window in which an add-on can be cancelled with no charge at all.
turns.message: Is there a free-look or cooling-off period where I can cancel an add-on with no charge at all?

turns.intent: Asks whether notes from an earlier call about the add-on are on file.
turns.message: I think I was told something on a previous call about this add-on. Do you have notes from that conversation?

turns.intent: Asks how to dispute an add-on charge they say they did not knowingly agree to.
turns.message: If I never really agreed to this add-on, what is the process for disputing the charge?

turns.intent: Asks which email and mailing address are on file so the cancellation confirmation goes to the right place.
turns.message: What email address and mailing address do you have on file for me, so I can confirm where the cancellation letter should go?

goal.persona: A self-employed contractor who fell behind on an FHA mortgage after a slow season is trying to get a forbearance or loan modification in place before foreclosure moves forward.

turns.intent: Wants to know how a forbearance plan works on an FHA mortgage and whether interest keeps building during it.
turns.message: How does a forbearance work on an FHA loan? Do I still owe interest on the months I'm paused?

turns.intent: Wants to see which payments on their own loan are currently shown as past due.
turns.message: Can you tell me which of my monthly payments are showing as past due on my loan right now?

turns.intent: Asks what documents are needed to apply for loss mitigation help on an FHA mortgage.
turns.message: What documents do I need to send in to apply for loss mitigation or a modification on an FHA loan?

turns.intent: Wants the notes from their earlier call about the hardship application they submitted.
turns.message: Can you pull up the notes from my last call about the hardship application I sent in?

turns.intent: Asks whether submitting a complete loss mitigation application stops a foreclosure sale from moving forward.
turns.message: If I send a complete loss mitigation application, does that stop the foreclosure process while it's being reviewed?

turns.intent: Wants to know what late fees have been charged to their loan and what phone number and mailing address are on file for them.
turns.message: What late fees have been added to my loan, and what phone number and mailing address do you have on file for me?

goal.persona: A self-employed contractor whose work hours have dropped sharply, leaving them behind on their conventional home mortgage and looking for hardship options before the situation gets worse.

turns.intent: Learn how hardship assistance works and whether reduced income qualifies.
turns.message: My work hours have been cut a lot lately. How does a hardship program work, and would it apply to someone whose income has dropped like mine?

turns.intent: Check whether the last mortgage payment posted and whether a late fee was added.
turns.message: Can you tell me whether my last payment was received and if any late fee has been charged to my account?

turns.intent: Understand the grace period and when late fees begin to apply.
turns.message: If I miss a payment, how long is the grace period before a late fee is charged?

turns.intent: Confirm the phone number and mailing address on file.
turns.message: Before I call back, can you confirm which phone number and mailing address you have on file for me?

turns.intent: Find out what documents are needed for a loan modification request and how long review takes.
turns.message: What documents would I need to submit to request a loan modification, and how long does the review usually take?

turns.intent: Ask whether notes from an earlier call mention a promised payment plan.
turns.message: I spoke with someone last week about my payments. Do you have any notes from that call about a payment plan I was promised?

goal.persona: A payday loan borrower who has already asked the lender in writing and by phone to stop contacting her, but collection calls and messages keep arriving.

turns.intent: Borrower wants to know what rights she has to stop collection contact about her payday loan.
turns.message: What rights do I have to make a lender stop calling me about my payday loan?

turns.intent: Borrower wants to confirm whether her request to stop calls is recorded on her account.
turns.message: Can you check whether my request to stop calls is actually recorded on my account?

turns.intent: Borrower asks whether a collector can still reach her by text or email after a written stop request.
turns.message: If I sent a written request to stop, can they still contact me by text or email?

turns.intent: Borrower wants the notes from her earlier calls where she asked for the contact to stop.
turns.message: Can you pull up the notes from my earlier calls where I asked for the calls to stop?

turns.intent: Borrower asks what she can do and how to file a complaint if the contact keeps happening.
turns.message: What can I do, and how do I file a complaint, if the calls keep coming after I asked them to stop?

turns.intent: Borrower wants the phone number and email address on file read back so she can verify them.
turns.message: Please read me the phone number and email you have on file for me so I can make sure they're correct.

goal.persona: A homeowner who fell behind on the mortgage after losing work and wants to understand hardship options before a foreclosure notice arrives.

turns.intent: Asks how a forbearance plan works and what happens to missed payments when it ends.
turns.message: How does a forbearance plan work, and what happens to the payments I missed when it ends? I want to understand before I agree to anything.

turns.intent: Asks for the status of the hardship application they submitted and whether anything is missing.
turns.message: Can you check the status of the hardship application I sent in? I want to know if anything is still missing from my file.

turns.intent: Asks what documents are usually required for a loan modification review.
turns.message: What documents do you usually need from me for a loan modification review? I'd rather gather everything now than delay the process.

turns.intent: Asks whether late fees or inspection charges were added to their loan after they reported lost income.
turns.message: Have any late fees or property inspection charges been added to my loan since I told you I lost my job? Please list anything you see.

turns.intent: Asks how a short sale differs from a deed in lieu if a modification is not possible.
turns.message: If I can't get a modification, what's the difference between a short sale and a deed in lieu of foreclosure? I'm trying to understand my options.

turns.intent: Asks which phone number and mailing address are on file and for the notes from the last call.
turns.message: What phone number and mailing address do you have on file for me? Also, can you read me the notes from my last call with your team?
